description.en: Bundles built for the DSH desktop shell. Third-party content: each entry declares what it installs, but the package's own manifest decides what actually runs.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端自建的组合包。第三方内容：条目只声明它装什么，真正运行什么由包自己的 manifest 决定。

description.en: Adds an IDE mode button to the conversation header: one click turns the main panel into a three-column workspace (file tree, an editable CodeMirror 6 code area with guarded Ctrl+S saving, and the real conversation embedded through the host's own renderer), with two draggable dividers.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏加一个 IDE 模式按钮：一键把主面板换成三栏工作区（文件树、带冲突保护的 Ctrl+S 保存的 CodeMirror 6 代码区、经宿主渲染器嵌入的真实对话），两条分隔线都可拖拽。
